elements_selected.content: Extend zetl reason provenance output with grounding freshness per REQ-044 and CON-012 extended. Changes to provenance output: 1) Each source entry gains a grounding object with: type ('section' or 'explicit'), section heading (if section type), source references (if explicit type), fresh (bool — current grounding hash matches cached), optional warning message when fresh=false, 2) Top-level fields: vault_root_hash (current vault Merkle root), theory_built_at (RFC3339 timestamp from theory cache), 3) When fresh=false, include a warning: 'Section prose changed since theory was built' or 'Source content changed since theory was built'. Compute freshness by comparing current section grounding hashes (from scanner) against the theory cache's stored hashes. No new commands — extend existing provenance output path in src/reason/mod.rs or main.rs. If the theory cache has no grounding hashes (first run or old cache), fresh=null.
